explanation: Fires at about 0.55-0.9 of max on a token that completes a fixed two-token unit with the token right before it: an unspaced ASCII hyphen glued between two digit groups (6-10, 9-5, 3-2, 449-456, 555-1234, 1990-2015, ISBN, DOI and date parts), 'abs' glued to '.' or 'f' in code (Math.abs, fabs, fabsf), ' of' right after 'made' or 'built', ' up' right after 'given' or 'made', and ' own' right after a possessive (my own, his own). The same tokens stay below 0.25 of max in near-miss slots: digits joined by ' to' instead of the hyphen, hyphens inside lowercase words (well-known, hard-working, self-taught), Math.max, min, sqrt or floor, prose 'absolute', 'absence' or 'absorb', ' of' after kind, part, full, cup or matter, ' up' after set, look, woke, climbed or turn, and the verb 'own' (I own, they own); unrelated content words in ordinary sentences give scattered weak peaks that only occasionally pass 0.25.
